---
name: Enhancement Proposal
about: Propose a piece of work before breaking it into issues and sub-issues
title: "[Enhancement] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## What
One or two sentences — what's being built or changed.

## Why
Which objective or hypothesis from the proposal this serves
(e.g., H2a spatial explanation validity, Phase 3 segmentation).

## How it will be tested
What passing looks like, concretely. If this touches patient identity or
data splitting anywhere, say so explicitly and link to
`tests/data/test_splitting.py`.

## Track
- [ ] Data / infra
- [ ] Classification
- [ ] Segmentation
- [ ] Radiomics / calibration / XAI
- [ ] Quantum ablation
- [ ] Demo / docs

## Breakdown into issues
List sub-issues here once opened, each scoped to land as one PR.
- [ ] #
- [ ] #
- [ ] #

## Out of scope
What this explicitly does *not* cover (keeps issues small and reviewable).
